svg.title: Figure 3 | Interface, rules and tests
svg.desc: These are parallel responsibilities, not a timeline. The interface and tests can call the same rule function.

g.font-family: Arial, Noto Sans CJK TC, sans-serif
g.text: Accept input, display errors and support corrections
Judge data independently of the interface
Check rules using valid and invalid data
These are parallel responsibilities, not a timeline. The interface and
tests can call the same rule function.
